description: Source code for HttpNegotiateAuthenticator class, which manages obtaining authentication tokens for HTTP Negotiate (Kerberos) authentication, including account management, token requests, and error handling.

classes.name: HttpNegotiateAuthenticator
classes.description: Manages obtaining and handling authentication tokens for HTTP Negotiate/Kerberos authentication, including account selection, token requests, and error reporting.

classes.name: HttpNegotiateAuthenticator.RequestData
classes.description: Holds request-specific data across asynchronous callbacks, including native result object, account info, options, and token type.

classes.name: HttpNegotiateAuthenticator.GetAccountsCallback
classes.description: Callback class to handle account retrieval results, including error handling and permission checks.

classes.name: HttpNegotiateAuthenticator.GetTokenCallback
classes.description: Callback class to handle token retrieval results, including processing intents for user interaction.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of HttpNegotiateAuthenticator with specified account type.

methods.name: getNextAuthToken
methods.description: Initiates the process to obtain the next authentication token for a given principal, auth token, and delegation permission.

methods.name: processResult
methods.description: Processes the result bundle from token requests and communicates status and token back to native code.

methods.name: requestTokenWithoutActivity
methods.description: Requests an auth token without user interaction, checking permissions and retrieving accounts.

methods.name: requestTokenWithActivity
methods.description: Requests an auth token with user interaction, handling account selection and credential confirmation.

methods.name: lacksPermission
methods.description: Checks if the current context lacks a specific permission, optionally skipping on newer Android versions.
